id.description: The unique identifier for the stats record. FK to [Promoted Tweets](./promoted-tweets.md)

country.description: Location ID from X Ads (hex string, e.g. 96683cc9126741d1). Join with the targeting_locations node to get the human-readable name and country code. FK to [Targeting Locations](./targeting-locations.md)

impressions.description: Times the promoted tweet was shown; X's engagement, click and follow rates divide by it.

qualified_impressions.description: Qualified impressions of the promoted tweet; X's qualified impression rate is this divided by `impressions`.

follows.description: Follows that came from the promoted tweet; X's cost per follow is `billed_charge_local_micro` divided by this.

app_clicks.description: App install or app open attempts from the promoted tweet.

unfollows.description: Unfollows; the current X Ads metrics table no longer lists it, and X's example responses return it as null.

engagements.description: Engagements with the promoted tweet as X sums them (clicks, replies, reposts, follows and more); X's engagement rate is this divided by `impressions`.

clicks.description: Clicks on the promoted tweet, including likes (favorites) and other engagements, per X; `url_clicks` counts only link clicks.

card_engagements.description: Engagements with the card attached to the promoted tweet.

url_clicks.description: Clicks on the link or Website Card in the ad, including earned clicks.

billed_engagements.description: Engagements X billed, from its BILLING metric group, as opposed to all `engagements`.

carousel_swipes.description: Swipes on carousel images or videos.

id.description: The unique identifier for the stats record. FK to [Promoted Tweets](./promoted-tweets.md)

impressions.description: Times the promoted tweet was shown; X's engagement, click and follow rates divide by it.

qualified_impressions.description: Qualified impressions of the promoted tweet; X's qualified impression rate is this divided by `impressions`.

follows.description: Follows that came from the promoted tweet; X's cost per follow is `billed_charge_local_micro` divided by this.

app_clicks.description: App install or app open attempts from the promoted tweet.

unfollows.description: Unfollows; the current X Ads metrics table no longer lists it, and X's example responses return it as null.

engagements.description: Engagements with the promoted tweet as X sums them (clicks, replies, reposts, follows and more); X's engagement rate is this divided by `impressions`.

clicks.description: Clicks on the promoted tweet, including likes (favorites) and other engagements, per X; `url_clicks` counts only link clicks.

card_engagements.description: Engagements with the card attached to the promoted tweet.

url_clicks.description: Clicks on the link or Website Card in the ad, including earned clicks.

billed_engagements.description: Engagements X billed, from its BILLING metric group, as opposed to all `engagements`.

carousel_swipes.description: Swipes on carousel images or videos.

reasons_not_servable.description: Reasons why the campaign is not servable. Stored as a JSON string.

purchase_order_number.description: The purchase order number set on the campaign; X's example responses show it as null.

account_id.description: ID of the account FK to [Accounts](./accounts.md)

id.description: The unique identifier for the card. FK to [All Cards](./all-cards.md)

components.description: Card components including media and buttons. Stored as a JSON string.

placements.description: List of placement targets (e.g. ALL_ON_TWITTER). Stored as a JSON string.

android_app_store_identifier.description: Google Play identifier of the app the line item promotes; setting it adds Android platform targeting, and app install and app engagement objectives need it or the iOS one.

categories.description: Array of category labels. Stored as a JSON string.

ios_app_store_identifier.description: App Store identifier of the app the line item promotes; setting it adds iOS platform targeting, and app install and app engagement objectives need it or the Android one.

campaign_id.description: ID of the parent campaign FK to [Campaigns](./campaigns.md)

line_item_id.description: ID of the parent line item FK to [Line Items](./line-items.md)

tweet_id.description: ID of the original tweet FK to [Tweets](./tweets.md)

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude) of the tweet, if available. Stored as a JSON string.

entities.description: Parsed entities in the tweet (mentions, hashtags, URLs, media, etc.). Stored as a JSON string.

display_text_range.description: Start/end indices for which portion of the tweet text to display. Stored as a JSON string.

in_reply_to_status_id_str.alias: In Reply To Status ID String

geo.description: Deprecated geographic information, if present. Stored as a JSON string.

scopes.description: Visibility scopes (e.g. { followers: false }). Stored as a JSON string.

place.description: Place (location) associated with the tweet, if any. Stored as a JSON string.

card_uri.description: URI of the associated Twitter Card. FK to [All Cards](./all-cards.md)

contributors.description: Array of contributors to the tweet, if any. Stored as a JSON string.

in_reply_to_user_id_str.alias: In Reply To User ID String

user.description: The user object of the author (contains id, id_str, etc.). Stored as a JSON string.

extended_entities.description: Extended media entities (e.g. video variants, additional media info). Stored as a JSON string.
